research_question: For frozen candidates whose event already exists, does restricted local refinement of start_sec/end_sec only improve Temporal IoU without violating Recall Guardrails?
hypothesis_status: Boundary refinement is the currently most worthwhile next bottleneck hypothesis from Stage 4.1 (boundary-involved 14/36, over_wide 11/36) plus Stage 4.3 (Selection family exhausted); it is NOT a proven effect.

data_roles.dev_tune: Only role allowed for development smoke and, if a parameter grid is ever preregistered, Dev-only parameter selection
data_roles.hard_stress: Frozen-method stress evaluation only, after method freeze and never before
data_roles.audit_diagnostic: Post-hoc diagnostic only, after Hard is complete; never for Prompt/threshold/padding/rule development

git_head_policy: Every refinement result embeds the execution Git HEAD in its Protocol/runtime binding; the later method-freeze artifact independently records the same commit after review acceptance.

BR-0.definition: Identity boundary control: refined_start_sec = original start_sec and refined_end_sec = original end_sec for every candidate; no model, no video, no parameters

BR-1.definition: Local Semantic Temporal Boundary Refiner: for each frozen merged candidate, build a clamped local context window around the candidate, show the model only that local clip, and ask for the same event's refined start/end; any parse, schema, guard, or model fallback outcome reverts to the original boundaries
BR-1.parameter_policy: Fixed conservative values for v1; not tuned on Audit36 or Smoke metrics. If a grid is ever introduced it must be preregistered here first and selected on Dev-Tune166 only.

model.backend: existing externally managed vLLM OpenAI-compatible server; no new inference framework

prompt_provenance.source: Generic boundary-refinement task description only; no Stage 4.1 per-video adjudication content, no video-specific rules, no audit rationales
prohibited_sources: Smoke metric-driven prompt edits after Formal begins

local_context_policy.window_definition: Frozen logical endpoints are accepted under the Stage 4.2 source-time tolerance (1e-6) and are never rewritten. For media access only, operational_end=min(frozen_end,duration), then window=[max(0,start-context_padding_sec),min(duration,operational_end+context_padding_sec)]; cap trimming is deterministic and keeps the operational candidate projection inside.
local_context_policy.input_scope: The model may only observe the extracted local clip; full-video re-entry is forbidden
local_context_policy.coordinate_system: The model returns seconds relative to the first decoded clip frame; source_sec = actual_source_origin_sec + local_sec. requested_source_start_sec, actual_source_origin_sec, and clip_duration_sec are recorded separately; frozen logical endpoints are never clamped or rewritten.
local_context_policy.clip_extraction: Frame-accurate decode/re-encode/trim via extract_video_clip (ffmpeg preferred, OpenCV fallback); stream copy is forbidden; source videos are read-only

temporal_parent_consistency_guard.purpose: Refinement must remain temporally consistent with the parent candidate. parent tIoU >= 0.5 is a temporal check only and does not prove semantic same-event identity.
checks: interval_valid: refined interval is finite, 0 <= refined_start < refined_end <= video duration
within_local_window: refined interval lies inside the recomputed operational local context window (1e-6 tolerance)
parent_temporal_iou: temporal_iou(original interval, refined interval) >= min_parent_temporal_iou
temporal_parent_consistency_guard.on_failure: Reject the model output and fall back to the original boundaries; the rejection reason and guard detail are recorded; nothing is silently repaired into a different event

triggers: response does not parse as the exact required JSON schema
model outputs boundaries identical to the original (no-op refine is recorded as REFINE with equal values)
fallback_policy.behaviour: IDENTITY_FALLBACK keeps the original start/end; candidate is never dropped, never created, never split, never merged

allowed_boundary_modifications: start_sec of an existing frozen merged candidate
end_sec of an existing frozen merged candidate
forbidden_operations: add, delete, split, or merge candidates
candidate selection, reranking, or budgeting (Stage 4.3 scope, closed)
modify score, reason, source, source_chunk, or any provenance field (structurally impossible: replay projects these from the frozen cache)
re-run retrieval or a second-pass highlight search over the whole video
read Audit36 adjudication before Hard is complete
use Audit36 observations to tune Prompt, padding, thresholds, or rules
alter SEL-3 frozen rules or config hash 7009da355490267818c7c01e0407874e79869ecefe3515125eea10ac1a072d7a

metric_definitions.status: weak-reference development metrics; NOT official competition metrics
metric_definitions.evaluation_schema_reuse: Evaluation and comparison reuse aic.candidate-selection-evaluation/v1 and aic.candidate-selection-comparison/v1 because the frozen metric contract is identical; the paired baseline is the same role's BR-0 identity evaluation.

gate_discipline: Gates must be applied exactly as written; a Recall Guardrail failure blocks Promotion regardless of Temporal IoU; no gate may be relaxed because Stage 4.3 was a negative result.
method_freeze_rule: BR-1 Prompt version, parameters, and gates are frozen in an overall_method_freeze.json artifact before any Hard-Stress record is read; the freeze artifact records hard_results_observed=false, audit_results_observed=false, heldout_accessed=false.

parameter_selection_rule.eligibility: BR-1 v1 uses fixed protocol parameters; there is no Dev grid in this version. If any future version introduces a grid, eligibility is passing every dev_recall_guardrail check and selection happens on Dev-Tune166 only.

formal_phases: Phase 0 validate Git, frozen cache, role manifests, and protocol hashes; freeze protocol status to PREREGISTERED_BEFORE_FORMAL after independent review acceptance
Phase 1 run BR-0 identity control on Dev-Tune166 and verify exact replay equivalence with the frozen baseline
Phase 2 run frozen BR-1 on Dev-Tune166
Phase 3 write overall_method_freeze evidence before Hard
Phase 4 run frozen BR-1 on Hard-Stress229 without feedback
Phase 5 apply preregistered promotion and Hard-Stress gates
Phase 6 only then permit Audit36 post-hoc diagnostic
Phase 7 statistical analysis, figures, and Markdown report
stopping_rules: Stop on any cache, role, protocol, refinement, replay, or evaluation hash mismatch
Stop if candidate count or candidate identity changes anywhere in the chain
Stop if any replayed score/reason/source differs from the frozen cache
Stop on reference/metric/Audit-label leakage into refinement inputs or outputs
Do not alter Prompt, parameters, guardrails, or gates after Formal begins

development_smoke_policy.purpose: Engineering plumbing only: BR-0 identity, BR-1 schema/fallback/validator, determinism; Smoke metrics must never be used to tune BR-1

audit_posthoc_policy: Audit36 stays locked until Phases 1-5 are complete; Audit output is diagnostic only and cannot change any frozen decision.
